title: Remarks on Topological Rigidity of Real Moment-Angle Manifolds
summary: We study topological rigidity of real moment-angle manifolds associated to flag simplicial complexes. Using the cubical geometry arising from the Davis construction, we identify the universal cover with the Davis complex and deduce that it admits a CAT(0) metric. As a consequence, its fundamental group satisfies the Farrell--Jones conjecture. Applying surgery theory, we deduce that real moment-angle manifolds of dimension at least five associated to flag complexes satisfy the Borel Conjecture.
